newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind to launch US$300 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind to launch US$300 mln loan.

text.p: Red chip conglomerate Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd has mandated two banks to arrange a US$300 million term loan facility, bankers said.
They said the arrangers now are expanding the arrangers group and inviting banks to join as underwriters. Each will underwrite US$25 million.
The amortising loan has a maturity of five-years and pays a margin of 60 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for underwriters is 67 basis points.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia and Chase Manhattan Asia are arrangers for the deal.
